name: Planting Justice Youth Internships
what_you_do: Paid youth internships at an urban farm and nursery: sustainable farming, food distribution, school gardens, with job training and food safety certifications and mentors from the community.
who_can_apply: No age or grade rule is stated. The program focuses on youth facing challenges such as hunger or homelessness and aims to keep them in school.
how_to_apply: Email your resume to jobs@plantingjustice.org, or call the East Oakland Nursery at 510-756-6965.
notes: Ages, season and hours are not stated, so call and ask. Pay is from the program page and may change.
